info.name: IRoute — Hard POD Flow (A7 → A7H)
info.description:
Complete driver mobile job flow from login to job closed.
Follows A1 through A10 as defined in IRoute document.
Use {{base_url}} variable = http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/mobile
Use {{access_token}} variable = filled automatically after login.
Use {{job_id}} variable = filled after dashboard call.
Use {{shipment_id}} variable = filled after A4 executes.
Use {{capture_bundle_id}} variable = filled after POD capture.

FLOW ORDER:
01 Login
02 Dashboard
03 Job Detail
04 Execute A1
05 Execute A2
06 Execute A3
07 Execute A4
08 Execute A5
09 Execute A6
10a POD Capture Sync (GET hash)
10 POD Capture (POST with photo)
11 Execute A7
12 Execute A8
13 Payment Collection (COD only)
14 Execute A10
15 Report Issue

HOW TO READ next_action_hint IN EVERY RESPONSE:

next_action_hint.action values:
  execute_action         = fire the action_code shown
  execute_action_with_media = fire action, use camera
  go_to_pod_capture      = open POD capture screen first
  go_to_payment_collection = open payment screen (COD)
  go_to_hard_pod         = open hard POD submit screen
  go_to_dashboard        = job done, go home
  wait_for_ops           = ops must verify, wait
  refresh_job_detail     = pull to refresh, try again

next_action_hint.job_closed values:
  true  = call Dashboard API, job done
  false = stay on job flow

CREDIT ORDER FLOW:
  A1 → A2 → A3 → A4 → A5 → A6
  → POD Capture Screen → A7
  → A8 → refresh → A10 → Dashboard

COD ORDER FLOW:
  A1 → A2 → A3 → A4 → A5 → A6
  → POD Capture Screen → A7
  → A8 → Payment Screen → A9
  → A10 → Dashboard

VIDEO + HARD POD (updated Jun 2026):
  10 POD Capture — photo + signature + optional video (max 15s, duration_seconds)
  11 Execute A7
  11b GET .../pod/capture/?step=hard_copy_confirmation — DN checklist
  11b-alt GET .../hard-pod/documents/ — dedicated Shipment Documents API
  11c POST .../hard-pod/submit/ — confirmed_pages[] required (all DN pages)
  11d POST .../actions/A7H/execute/ — custody_submission_id from 11c
  12 Execute A8 → ...
Skip 11b–11d for digital/soft POD shipments.

request.description:
EMAIL LOGIN — tenant_id optional.
Send email + password only; tenant resolves from driver record.
Add tenant_id only if the same email exists on multiple subscribers.

exec: pm.test("Login successful, token saved", function() { pm.expect(resp.status).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("Login failed — check email and password", function() { pm.expect(resp.status).to.eql(1); });

request.description:
ALTERNATIVE LOGIN — USE PHONE NUMBER INSTEAD OF EMAIL.

Use this request if the driver does not have an email
or prefers to login with phone number.

Required fields:
  extension = country code e.g. +966 or +91
  phone = phone number without extension e.g. 987456321
  password = driver password

tenant_id is OPTIONAL (multi-subscriber disambiguation only).

Set driver_extension and driver_phone in
collection variables before running.

Same response as email login.
access_token is auto-saved after success.

Only run ONE login request (01 or 01b).
Both save the same access_token variable.

STEP 2 — CALL AFTER LOGIN.
Returns active job assigned to driver.
job_id and job_type are auto-saved from response.
job_type will be 'shipment' for normal delivery jobs.
If no active_job in response then no job is assigned yet.
Check data.active_job.job_id and data.active_job.job_type.
These variables are used in all job detail and action calls.

exec: throw new Error('access_token is missing. Run 01 \u2014 Login first. Set driver_email and driver_password in the active environment.');
pm.test("Active job found, job_id saved", function() { pm.expect(resp.data.active_job.job_id).to.exist; });
pm.test("No active job assigned to driver", function() { pm.expect(resp.data.active_job).to.exist; });

request.description:
STEP 3 — CALL TO SEE FULL JOB STATE BEFORE ANY ACTION.
URL uses job_type and job_id from dashboard response.
job_type is usually 'shipment'.
Response shows current state, next allowed action, cargo, addresses.
Check data.next_action to know which action to fire next.
Check data.shipment_id — will be null until A4 fires.
This API can be called anytime to refresh job state.

IMPORTANT: Call Job Detail before the FIRST execute only.
After each execute fires, sync_metadata is automatically
updated from the execute response.
You do NOT need to re-call Job Detail between actions
as long as you run them in order.
Only call Job Detail again if you skip a step or
if you get a 409 stale_content_hash error.

item.name: 10a — POD Capture Sync (Get Hash Before Upload)

request.description:
STEP 10a — MUST CALL THIS BEFORE REQUEST 10.
Returns content_hash and workflow_version
specifically for POD Capture API.
These are DIFFERENT from Job Detail hash.
POD Capture hash = shipment.updated_at ISO string.
Job Detail hash = full fingerprint digest.
Do NOT mix them up.
pod_content_hash and pod_workflow_version are
saved automatically for use in Request 10.

exec: console.log("*** JOB CLOSED — GO TO DASHBOARD ***");

  media[2] video — optional, max 15s (set duration_seconds)

pod_type=digital. Saves capture_bundle_id for A7.

item.name: 13 — Execute A9 — Collect Payment COD Only

request.description:
STEP 13 — COD PAYMENT COLLECTION (COD ORDERS ONLY).
SKIP THIS STEP FOR CREDIT ORDERS.

THIS USES EXECUTE ACTION API — same as all other actions.
NOT the /payments/collect/ staging API.

REQUIRED FIELDS:
  mobile_cod_amount = actual cash collected from customer
  notes = required (note says what amount was collected)
  workflow_version and content_hash from Job Detail

WHAT HAPPENS WHEN A9 FIRES:
  - Driver Treasury Transaction created (Debit, Client Pay)
  - Driver wallet balance increases by collected amount
  - Shipment COD Payment Status = Collected
  - If amount differs from expected: variance flagged for Ops
  - Driver is NEVER blocked due to variance

VARIANCE HANDLING:
  Change mobile_cod_amount to actual amount received.
  If different from 1500.00 that is fine.
  System records variance and Ops follows up.
  Driver proceeds normally to A10.

IMPORTANT: Always run 03 Job Detail before this request
to refresh content_hash and workflow_version.

Next action after A9: A10 Job Closed.

exec: console.log("*** JOB CLOSED — GO TO DASHBOARD ***");

request.description:
REFERENCE ONLY — NOT REQUIRED FOR COD FLOW.

This is a staging API for pre-registering payment intent.
It does NOT fire A9.
It does NOT collect the payment.
It does NOT create a Treasury Transaction.

USE THIS ONLY IF:
  Your app needs to stage payment metadata
  before the driver physically collects cash.

FOR NORMAL COD FLOW: Use Request 13 Execute A9 instead.

WARNING: This API validates file paths strictly.
Do NOT attach files unless paths follow this pattern:
  mobile_driver_uploads/{tenant}/{driver}/{shipment}/
  payment_collection/filename.jpg
Send proof_media as empty array [] for testing.
